claims.evidence: Complete original frozen audit, every exact native/physical diagonal, cache, state, restoration and counter guard.
claims.permitted: The prescribed four native-state controls executed and reconstructed the tested native and local physical outputs under the fixed measurement inputs.
claims.limit: Engineering feasibility on these cases and sites; no general method novelty, useful program gain or full-transformer insertion.

claims.evidence: Per-cell full-FP32-logit hash and native argmax, distinct from numeric L2 and maximum-absolute shifts.
claims.permitted: A zero reported L2 means zero numerical full-logit difference at the saved FP32 metric precision. Exact byte identity requires the appropriate full-logit hash equality.
claims.limit: Do not infer byte identity from zero norm alone: signed zeros can have equal numerical value and different bytes. An unchanged argmax alone is still weaker and does not imply unchanged logits.

claims.evidence: Frozen effects() calculates a norm for each full-vocabulary difference vector, then the auditor takes case-balanced means.
claims.permitted: Report the mean of per-record finite-effect norms using the saved equal-case calculation.
claims.limit: This is not the norm of an averaged vector or a measure of coherent direction across cases. Vocabulary-wide L2 is not program correctness or latency.

claims.evidence: Cosine is undefined when either per-record raw or normalization difference vector has zero norm; the auditor omits those undefined rows within cases.
claims.permitted: Report the saved cosine mean together with its defined-case denominator and zero-path record counts.
claims.limit: Undefined is not zero. Negative mean cosine is a vector relationship in output-logit coordinates, not an inhibitory semantic neuron or a fraction of mediation.

claims.evidence: Interaction is delta11 minus delta10 minus delta01, with native arithmetic and BF16 output casting followed by downstream model computation.
claims.permitted: The finite factorial controls can be nonadditive; report their interaction without fitting coefficients.
claims.limit: Do not divide these effects into additive causal percentages or assign a unique biological or semantic pathway meaning.

claims.evidence: One layer subset at a time, all 96 original native histories, fixed quarter positions and current-position normalization output replacement.
claims.permitted: Compare layer-local effects under identical consumed native inputs.
claims.limit: This is not the N41 global all-position deletion, an entire free-generation trajectory intervention, or an established explanation of its four selected coding regressions.

claims.evidence: All three original fixed groups remain, with exactly matched per-layer member counts and original discovery matching.
claims.permitted: Describe selected and both random effects across every site, family, role and cell.
claims.limit: A larger or smaller selected effect does not itself identify a coding function. No effect-dependent site, group, strength, coordinate or task replacement is allowed.

claims.evidence: The last KV-producing layer is 14; every edited site is 24 or later; probes branch from an independent exact native pre-decision cache.
claims.permitted: Report any complete same-input cache identity witness as a bounded consequence of these late intervention sites.
claims.limit: Do not infer equality after consumed histories diverge, faster inference, causal mediation strength or improved memory.

claims.evidence: State snapshots cover parameter versions, shapes, dtypes and gradflags; buffers, configurations and RNG have hashes; physical contexts hash actual original/edited/restored matrices and other columns.
claims.permitted: State and restoration claims refer to this combination of version metadata, scoped tensor hashes, hooks, configuration, RNG and exact behavioral replay.
claims.limit: The host does not recompute all checkpoint weights, raw factors or full logits. It is not an independent post-run byte hash of every model parameter or an independent clean-package pretrained replay.

claims.evidence: Worker loops over saved original IDs and calls decision() for witnesses; no active worker/assay call to extend, greedy, generate, backward or an optimizer step.
claims.permitted: N43 is measurement-only with zero new response generation by design. Legacy capped helper definitions remain preserved in imported historical modules but are uninvoked here.
claims.limit: A source search finding total_cap=2048 in an old helper is not evidence of an active N43 token ceiling. New free inference remains native-EOS under human U23; old recorded grades are not rewritten.

claims.evidence: Parameter increments and activation replacements are counted separately from optimizer and backward calls.
claims.permitted: Manual fixed column assignments, exact restoration and declared native-factor activation assignments are explicit interventions.
claims.limit: Do not present zero optimizer updates as zero intervention or label actual native-factor reuse as learned or fitted.

claims.evidence: Terminal failure/resource status, original source hashes, private manifest and single frozen collector/auditor.
claims.permitted: A failed exact guard is an engineering failure; actual wall-time, memory or storage interruption is incomplete/censored.
claims.limit: Neither is a completed scientific null. Preserve first failures; no weakening of the audit or rerun of completed cells.

claims.evidence: N41 fresh primary is closed: original 55/64, selected 51/64 with zero gains and four losses; all new replies reach native EOS. N43 generates no programs and has no correctness endpoint.
claims.permitted: The fixed global selected-zero utility lead failed on that fresh panel. N43 may inform a later separately prospective mechanistic question.
claims.limit: No N43effect can retroactively rescue that primary, establish useful coding/personality/knowledge gain or justify a replacement strength/rank from the failed outcomes.

decision: Original terminal guard and single-audit flow stays authoritative. This map limits wording; it adds no numerical threshold,analysis rerun,ranking,dose or scientific acceptance criterion.
edition: Reviewed public wording of a static source-to-claim map; private source paths omitted. No N43 outcome or original acceptance criterion is added.
